_doc: TRIAL<->REPORT entity model: records that are SECONDARY / POOLED / DUPLICATE reports of an already-counted trial, so screening collapses them to their parent (X-DEDUP) BEFORE any count is promoted to a trial count. Screening operates at REPORT level while PRISMA and prose speak at TRIAL level; without this, secondary analyses and registry<->publication pairs inflate the eligible-trial count (esketamine, metformin-pcos). Audit-identified; each entry names the parent and the report kind. This CUTS BOTH WAYS -- it corrects counts that were inflated, not only understated.

esketamine-trd-madrs.kind: secondary factor-analysis of two already-counted RCTs
secondary analysis of two already-counted RCTs
pooled analysis of two already-counted studies
post-hoc pooled analysis of four already-counted studies
pooled analysis of four already-counted phase-3 studies
pooled analysis of five already-counted studies
primary publication of an already-pooled trial (registry<->publication duplicate)

metformin-pcos-ovulation.kind: secondary publication of an already-counted RCT
secondary publication of an already-counted RCT

colchicine-secondary-cv-prevention.kind: economic evaluation of already-pooled COLCOT primary trial
secondary/subgroup publication of already-pooled LoDoCo2 primary trial

melatonin-primary-insomnia-sol.kind: further analysis of the same trial (companion report): one trial, one family, never a second trial
post-hoc pooled analysis of four RCTs (its safety set also pools single-blind and open-label studies): linked to its constituent trials, never new participants

sacubitril-valsartan-hfref.parent: PARALLEL-HF (NCT02468232, contributing through its registry record)
sacubitril-valsartan-hfref.kind: primary publication of an already-pooled registry trial: one trial, one family, one design decision (double-blind, held full text), never a second trial and never a design exclusion

design_witness.span: Briefly, the study was a multicenter, randomized, double-blind study

semaglutide-obesity-mace.kind: prespecified secondary analysis of SELECT by baseline HbA1c: never a new trial; its subgroup HRs are never pooled alongside the overall result. Its held abstract states the SAME population (the X2 'population not established' came from a title-keyword test, not from the source)

population_witness.span: In SELECT, people with overweight or obesity and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease without diabetes were randomized to weekly semaglutide 2.4 mg or placebo.

semaglutide-obesity-mace.kind: SELECT's dedicated safety report (Kushner et al., Obesity 2025): the source of the collection rules. Outcome-specific source selection: it never supersedes the primary report's MACE result

sglt2-ckd-progression.kind: long-term follow-up of the SAME trial (active + post-trial): a separate follow-up policy (strategy continuity fails), never a second trial and never a replacement of the active-trial result

ticagrelor-vs-clopidogrel-acs.kind: prespecified diabetes substudy of PLATO: a SUBGROUP report of an already-pooled trial -- one trial, one design decision (the X-DESIGN exclusion read a substudy abstract silent on masking); its subgroup HRs are never pooled alongside the overall result
